title: The One About the River
subtitle: 信念与信仰 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 信念与信仰（做人与做事·信念与价值观）
meta: 主题语境：信念与信仰（做人与做事·信念与价值观）　|　核心词汇：belief　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 belief 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my grandfather held ① a belief he had been given at nine and never examined, and my grandmother said the not examining was the whole of the belief. The ② belief, meaning the conviction and not the argument, held for eleven years and survived one war; a belief, he said, is the only thing you can hold without being able to show it.

Every ③ belief in that house was inherited, and the ④ belief about the river, meaning the one about the water and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever acted on. A belief, my mother said, is nine parts inheritance and one part a day it turns out to be useful; my grandmother said the inheritance is the part nobody chooses.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ belief was the whole of the trust, meaning the confidence and not the conviction. The ⑥ belief, meaning the faith in somebody and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that is given once and withdrawn once; a belief, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both a conviction and a trust. She said the trust is the part that breaks.

By 1966 the ⑦ belief had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about who had written it first. The ⑧ belief of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in April, was nine years of not examining and one war; a belief, he said, is either the thing about the river or the reason you never asked. She said the asking was the part that frightened everybody.

The ⑨ belief I remember is the one about the river, which was acted on for forty years and never once explained. A ⑩ belief, my mother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being unexamined; every belief, she said, is a trust that has agreed to look like a conviction. He said the trust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 信念（指那份确信，与争论相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold a belief 持有一种信念
D. n. 信念（指屋里每一种）
E. n. 信念（指关于那条河的那一种）
F. n. 信任；信心（指对人的信任）
G. n. 信任（抽象：那种信心）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a belief he had been given at nine
The belief, meaning the conviction and not the argument
belief was the whole of the trust
The belief, meaning the faith in somebody
the belief had become a line in a letter
The belief of the whole thing
A belief, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: hold a belief 意为“持有一种信念”，1947 年祖父守着一种他九岁就被给予、却从没审视过的信念。
belief 意为“信念”，指那份确信而不是争论，它守了十一年，熬过了一场战争。
belief 指屋里每一种信念，那屋里每一种都是继承来的。
belief 指关于那条河的那一种信念（关于水的那一种），是唯一有人照着做的。
belief 意为“信任、信心”，指对人的信任，父亲说 belief 就是那份信任的全部。
belief 为抽象用法，指那种信心，是家里唯一给一次、收一次的东西。
belief 意为“信念”，到 1966 年这个 belief 成了信里的一行字。
belief 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖父四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的不审视和一场战争。
belief 意为“信念”，我记得的是关于那条河的那一种，照着做了四十年，从没被解释过。
belief 为抽象总称，母亲说信念是唯一会因为不被审视而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1947 年祖父守着一种他九岁就被给予、却从没审视过的信念，祖母说不去审视才是这个信念的全部。（hold a belief）
那个信念，指的是那份确信而不是争论，守了十一年，熬过了一场战争。（belief）
那屋里每一种信念都是继承来的。（belief）
关于那条河的那种信念，指的是关于水的那一种，是唯一有人照着做的。（belief）
父亲说 belief 就是那份信任的全部，指的是对人的信心而不是那份确信。（belief）
1969 年母亲说，信念是唯一会因为不被审视而变好的东西。（belief）
answers: In 1947 my grandfather held a belief he had been given at nine and never examined, and my grandmother said the not examining was the whole of the belief.
The belief, meaning the conviction and not the argument, held for eleven years and survived one war.
Every belief in that house was inherited.
The belief about the river, meaning the one about the water and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever acted on.
My father said belief was the whole of the trust, meaning the confidence and not the conviction.
A belief, my mother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being unexamined.
